Subject: ZenHealth SOC 2 / security follow-up and evidence request

Hi Sasha / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the next steps we agreed on: 

Summary of pain / goals
- You need SOC 2 alignment for new integrations with patient data retention requirements (HIPAA-adjacent compliance).
- Audit log detail and retention are primary gating items for your security and procurement teams.
- Expected go-live target for pilot with Redwood: Q4 2026; must pass internal security review by mid-Sep.

What Redwood can provide (high level)
- SOC 2 readiness pack and our latest SOC 2 report (we can provide SOC 2 Type II once finalized; readiness materials included today).
- Detailed audit log export options (per-request, per-tenant) and configurable retention policies.
- DPA and security addenda; we support customer-managed keys in Private deployments and have KMS integrations.

Action items / next steps (owners & timelines)
1) Marissa: Share SOC 2 readiness pack, recent infra pen-test summary, and DPA draft (attached). Deliverable: Redwood_SOC2_Readiness_Pack.zip, redwood-scan-2026-05-30.pdf, DPA_Redwood_v3.2-signed.pdf — by EOD Thu (attached).
2) Sasha / Priya: Send list of specific evidence requests from procurement/security (logs format, retention window, encryption requirements) — by Mon 6/22.
3) Alex (Eng): Stand up a short demo of audit log export (CSV + JSON) and retention config for the ZenHealth tenant — ETA Tue 6/23.
4) Neha (AE): Schedule a joint call with your security reviewer and our product security SME for the week of 6/29.

Attachments referenced below. If you can send the evidence checklist from your procurement team, we'll map items to the artifacts in the readiness pack and identify any gaps.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Marissa — thanks for the thorough recap and the attachments. Quick notes from our side after a skim: 

- Procurement will compile a formal evidence checklist but high-priority items: detailed audit log schema (what fields are logged for API calls), retention configuration per-tenant, proof of encryption at rest and in transit, and data deletion/erasure procedure.
- Our security reviewer also asked for the most recent penetration test summary (cvss breakdown preferred) and whether you can share mitigation timelines for any open findings.
- DPA looks mostly fine; procurement will route redlines back to you for legal review.

Two asks for Redwood before the call next week: 
1) Can Alex provide a sample audit log export (anonymized) for our review — JSON and CSV preferred.
2) Can you confirm retention windows possible (30/90/365/ever) and whether they can be set per-tenant or only global?

I can have the evidence checklist to you by Monday 6/22. Also looping Priya since she owns procurement.

Thanks,
Sasha
Security Lead | ZenHealth

Hi Sasha / Priya —

Thanks — appreciate the checklist ETA. Quick answers inline and deliverables from our side: 

1) Sample audit log export: Alex attached anonymized samples (JSON + CSV) to the shared Drive link below. The export includes: timestamp, tenant_id, user_id (hashed), request_path, request_method, response_code, latency_ms, bytes_in, bytes_out, caller_ip (masked), and any matched tool/function call metadata. Exports can be generated on-demand for a date range and include filters by tenant_id.

2) Retention windows: We support per-tenant retention policies in our Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted customers we offer configurable retention tiers: 30, 90, 365, and indefinite (subject to contract). We can set default at account level and override per-tenant for Dedicated/Private.

3) Pen test summary: redwood-scan-2026-05-30.pdf in the attachments includes CVSS breakdown and remediation status. For any critical/high findings that are still open we can provide expected mitigation timelines and patch commits.

4) DPA / legal: DPA_Redwood_v3.2-signed.pdf attached — happy to accept redlines and coordinate legal reviews.

Next steps we propose: 
- Alex: Please confirm the Drive link has the anonymized audit logs and a short README describing the fields.
- Neha: I will schedule the security deep-dive call for Tue 6/30 10:00am PT with our product security SME and engineering to walk through export examples and retention config.
- Sasha / Priya: Send the procurement evidence checklist; we'll map artifacts and flag gaps clearly in a shared tracker.

Shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/zenhealth/SC-2026-evidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321

Let me know if you'd prefer a shorter technical pre-read before the call.

—
Marissa
